name: Download every image from a website (zip) with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Download every image from a website (zip) with MiroMiro

### How it works
Collect every image from a web page in one run, for designers, developers and content teams. The page comes from **Set Website URL**. **Fetch Images from MiroMiro** opens the page and lists every image it shows: img tags, srcset sizes, picture sources, CSS backgrounds, favicons and the og:image. Duplicate URLs are removed, each file is downloaded, and everything is packed into one zip named after the site. A download that fails is skipped and counted, so one broken link does not stop the run. If the page has no images or cannot be reached, the workflow stops with a message that says why. Failed calls are not charged.

### Setup
This template uses the verified community node **n8n-nodes-miromiro** (tested with version 0.1.4 on n8n 1.123).
1. On n8n Cloud, search "MiroMiro" in the nodes panel (an admin may need to turn on Verified Community Nodes). Self-hosted: Settings > Community nodes > Install `n8n-nodes-miromiro`, see https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
2. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
3. Open **Fetch Images from MiroMiro** > Credential > Create new, and paste the key.
4. Set your page in **Set Website URL** and click **Execute workflow**. Download the zip from **Compress Images into Zip File** > Binary.

Each page costs 1 credit, however many images it has. The same page again within 24 hours is free.

### Customization
For images that only load when you scroll, open **Fetch Images from MiroMiro** > Additional Options > Render in a Browser (+5 credits). Use a Schedule trigger or a Google Sheets list for many pages, and send the zip to Google Drive or email. To keep only some files, filter the URLs in **Prepare Image URLs**. Pages behind a login cannot be read.

![The workflow, in case the preview does not load](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoraiaBarroso/n8n-nodes-miromiro/main/docs/templates/download-every-image.png)

## Start and configure

Starts the workflow manually and sets the website URL that will be scanned for images.

## Find image URLs

Uses MiroMiro to list images on the configured page, then converts the results into one deduplicated item per image URL.

## Download and zip

Downloads each image, gathers all downloaded binaries onto a single item, and compresses them into one ZIP file.
